capabilities: Track current and longest note activity streaks
Chart weekly, monthly, yearly and all-time trends
Toggle between new-note and modified-note metrics
Drill down from a chart point to the matching note list
Record per-day edit history in plugin data
disambiguation: Not a general log of app events; it counts note creation and per-day edits and shows them as stats and charts.
extras: Edit history is stored per device and starts at install, so earlier edits cannot be recovered; frontmatter-only changes do not count as edits. Local-first, with no external analytics.
motivation: The primary goal is to make note capture and maintenance visible.
problem: Obsidian gives no view of whether notes are actually being revisited and updated over time, so a vault can fill with unrefined captures.

relations.evidence: use Vault Activity alongside the Update modified date plugin

summary: Dashboard that tracks note creation and edit activity, with streaks, trend charts and click-through note lists.
